name: qa-e2e-automation-cypress
description: Projeto E2E com Cypress + Allure Report

scripts.cy:run: npm run allure:clear && cypress run && npm run allure:history && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.cy:run:ci: npm run allure:clear && cypress run && npm run allure:history && npm run allure:generate
scripts.cy:run:chrome: npm run allure:clear && cypress run --browser chrome && npm run allure:history && npm run allure:generate
scripts.cy:run:headed: npm run allure:clear && cypress run --headed && npm run allure:history && npm run allure:generate
scripts.cy:run:dev: npm run allure:clear && cypress run --env environment=dev && npm run allure:history && npm run allure:generate
scripts.cy:run:hml: npm run allure:clear && cypress run --env environment=hml && npm run allure:history && npm run allure:generate

author: Andre
